data.body: Preparation checkpoint (2026-08-24): synchronized the dedicated worktree to origin/main 630faa37f1fb with no overlap in the six recorded file-impact paths. Integrated the held-out rewrite oracle into the tracked suite: graph/topology and metadata parity, retained-blob and bridge-byte parity, full target/unaffected replay, fsck, failed-import cleanup/retry, no-push instrumentation, source/remote drift refusal, mid-run remote movement cleanup, and independent bundle rollback. Corrected the Jira inventory contract from flattened rendered_body/snake-case fields to raw Jira Cloud REST v3 pages (startAt/maxResults/total, nested author.accountId, raw ADF body); the builder now invokes the production reconciler normalize_rich_text path and binds the derived normalized body in the manifest. Focused evidence: manifest 9/9 and rewrite 6/6 pass; rewriter is exactly 800 LOC. No Jira mutation, writer pause, remote ref update, force-with-lease, or authoritative-history rewrite has occurred.
